generate_supernet: generate a neural architecture search supernet structure with all operations enabled for a given node count
convert_encoding_to_masks: convert a flat encoding vector into normal and reduce cell masks for NAS architecture representation
define_search_space: define a hit-and-run search space with inequality constraints and a random initialization point
mask_specific_operation: mask a specific operation in the supernet by setting its value to zero at a given node and input
select_specific_operation: select a specific operation in the supernet by zeroing out all other operations at a given node and input
